lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of circular high-luminance clusters organized into distinct vertical columns. Inter-blob distance is relatively uniform within columns but increases along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity aligned with the blob columns, forming a grid pattern where they intersect the horizontal planes of the blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a pronounced light-to-dark vertical pixel gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Numerous diffuse, high-luminance clusters distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a random but clustered spatial arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated symbiotic organisms (remoras) are visible, with distinct individuals attached to the posterior-lateral margin of the pectoral fin and others trailing ventrally.
